# Provenance: entry_picks_self

**Source**: live `GET /api/entry/8450051/event/4/picks/` from the real FPL API on
2026-10-20 (curl, no auth), for #116.

**Edits**: a self-cohort id, gameweek 4 (a triple-captain week, `active_chip: "3xc"`); untrimmed, because the
shape check needs the full 15 picks. Values are otherwise as received (re-indented, key order kept). The response carries no manager or team names, so none were removed.
